chapter: Youth, Storyville and the bands he heard
title: First bands he heard: Perez and William Moreira
summary: The first band he heard had Manuel Perez on trumpet and a valve trombone; also William Moreira's band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: You were talking about how you listen to bands and that's how you get inspired to play music. Uh-huh. And who were the first bands you heard?

Well, the first band I heard was when I told you, the trumpet player in that band was Manuel Perez. Uh-huh. See, and I liked his style of playing, see. In fact, I was more interested in him than I was in the balance of the band, see. And with that band, they had a man playing trombone, a valve trombone or a tenor. I don't know what you call that instrument, a tenor or a valve trombone. Well, it had valves. Yeah. Is that a tenor or a trombone?
I call it a valve trombone.
I call it a valve trombone too, but I heard some people call it a tenor.
Well, a slide trombone is a tenor trombone. I used to study under Mineta, remember? Oh, yeah, yeah. I studied the slide trombone, which is a tenor, you know, it's that B-flat trombone. Yeah.

Who was playing that horn? Do you remember that? No, I don't know, I don't remember who was playing that horn. The only one I can remember playing the horn was that man Perez and the reason I remember him, because I was more interested in what he was doing than the balance of it. And what other bands did you remember around that time? Other bands, what I was supposed to play that time, well. This is before you started playing. Yeah, that was before I started playing. And I heard another one, I can remember the B-street's name, they ever tried to call his name. William Moreira, do you know William Moreira? Billy Moreira they called him. Yeah, that's the daddy of John's father. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, well I remember him and this other band, what I used to listen to do on Saturday. They played in a different place, see. But I don't remember nobody else in that band either. What year was that?
